suite.name: no_retry_dedupe
suite.meaning: a redelivery of a queued event re-runs the handler

suite.name: exit_after_queue
suite.meaning: events after a failed one in the same delivery are dropped

suite.name: no_expiry
suite.meaning: a stale row is replayed late

suite.name: expiry_before_ingested_check
suite.meaning: an expired row is dead-lettered although another delivery ingested its event

suite.name: expiry_drops_last_error
suite.meaning: expiry overwrites the error that queued the row

suite.name: unique_violation_only
suite.meaning: an uncaught error aborts the whole batch

suite.name: no_already_ingested_check
suite.meaning: the handler re-runs for an event another delivery already ingested

suite.name: uncapped_attempt
suite.meaning: a re-queued row at the bound breaks the CHECK and aborts the batch

suite.name: ingest_utc_wall_time
suite.meaning: a first group delivery stores a shifted received_at in a non-UTC session

suite.name: utc_wall_time
suite.meaning: received_at is shifted in a non-UTC session

suite.name: keep_last_error
suite.meaning: the old error text survives success

suite.name: no_fail_closed_check
suite.meaning: a privilege leaked through role membership is accepted

suite.name: service_role_keeps_defaults
suite.meaning: service_role keeps its default table privileges (fail-closed check also removed)

suite.name: no_column_read_check
suite.meaning: a column-level read leaked through role membership is accepted
